summary.text: Brandy Fluker-Reid is a Democratic state representative from the 12th Suffolk District who has held the seat since January 6, 2021 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. She is an attorney and former public defender.

paragraphs.text: Brandy Fluker-Reid, formerly Brandy Fluker Oakley, was born in Boston and graduated from Boston Latin School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Syracuse University and a J.D. from Emory University.
Her career experience includes working as an elementary school teacher, public defender, and policy advocate.
She succeeded Dan Cullinane in the 12th Suffolk District seat in 2021.
